settings.title: Product details
settings.content:
• Genuine leather adjustable bracelet.
  • Three stainless-steel engraving plates.
  • Four horizontal engraving placements: two on the square plate and one on each slim plate.
  • Maximum six characters per line.

settings.title: How engraving works
settings.content: 1. Enter up to six characters for each of the four horizontal lines. 2. Check every placement in the live preview. 3. We send a photo proof before your bracelet ships.
